text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds
with Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Why have you been
slacking off on training this whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up. It's none of your business.
Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I know those guys.
They were getting along just fine until recently,
but lately all they do is fight.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What's with that attitude...!
If you're not even motivated, why are you at Tracen Academy!?

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...!
Why do I have to take that from you...?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oops, better get moving soon.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, whoa, hold on! Stop this tacky brawling right now!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Inari-senpai...
This has nothing to do with you, does it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Can't do that either. Look around ya.
You guys made such a racket,
everyone's gettin' worried now, ain't they?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even so, leavin' things like this ain't gonna sit right with ya, yeah? What do ya say?
Care to leave this fight in the hands of Lady Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —In the end, you settle things on the track! That's what being an Umamusume is all about.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Gladly! There's no way
I'll ever lose to someone who's constantly slacking off!

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What about you?
Don't tell me you're chickening out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well now, who do you think is gonna
win this match, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Isn't it the one who's training, after all?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so?
...Well, let's see it through to the end.
However... to everyone's surprise, the one who scored an overwhelming victory was the Umamusume rumored to be slacking off on her training!

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! D-Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I didn't wanna face you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what's with that face?
You won, but you're wearing an awfully gloomy expression, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...My blooming period has begun.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
At first, I was happy.
I kept getting ridiculously faster and faster, to the point even I couldn't wrap my head around it.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still... gradually,
I started to feel guilty about running.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm leaving this behind
and just rushing ahead on my own...
Like that's what's happening—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. My partner opened their heart and spoke their mind.
How about you?

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...Tch, I knew it all along! About your growth spurt! Way before now!"

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Even so, I decided I'd catch up to you... because I wanted to keep running with you forever!

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Keep facing forward and run like you are right now!
I will definitely catch up, so don't you dare look back!

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“...... Sorry. I was being an idiot.
I'll train properly and get even faster.
All while believing you'll catch up to me.”

text_block_list.name: Feisty Umamusume
text_block_list.text: *Hic*... *hic*... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gloomy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Inari-senpai... Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Good grief, folks who don't know how a real brawl works are hopeless.
choice_data_list: That's the result of clashing with everything you had.
That's the result of clashing with everything you had, huh.
You wrapped that up nice and quick.
You wrapped that up nice and quick, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Good grief, folks who don't know how a real brawl works are hopeless.
choice_data_list: That's the result of clashing with everything you had.
That's the result of clashing with everything you had, huh.
You wrapped that up nice and quick.
You wrapped that up nice and quick, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's how it is. Well, it'd be nice if we could just speak our minds from the start, though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If so, then we clash until we're totally exhausted. That's the secret to a real fight!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is. If you and I ever
get into a fight, Trainer,
make sure you hit me with everything you've got!

...That was such a hearty, bold solution,
so typical of Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, cut it out. It was nothin'.
I just gave 'em directions, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: “—Well then. Watching those guys run got me all itching to go. Guess I'll jog a lap or so myself!”
With those words, Inari One ran off as if to hide her embarrassment.
